summary: When the shift offset is non-zero, computes the length of the source byte string with Strlen and block-moves the whole string including its NUL terminator (length + 1 bytes) from a1 to a1+a2, effectively shifting the string right by a2 bytes to open space for an insertion. No-op when a2 is zero. Called by sub_58BE2E (0058BE2E) and UtilityFunction_bf45 (0058BF45).

local_names.a2: byte offset to shift the string right by

operations.description: If a2 == 0 the function is a no-op; the body runs only for a non-zero shift offset
v2 = Strlen(a1): length of the string being shifted
v2 + 1: byte count including the NUL terminator, passed as the length argument
sub_58B130(a1 + a2, a1, v2 + 1): block copy of the string onto itself at offset a2, shifting it right
